option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and genetic findings, including the SUFU gene mutation, are consistent with multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome.
Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma is a type of basal cell carcinoma that can be seen in the context of multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome.
Basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin syndrome) is a distinct genetic disorder that is characterized by a different set of clinical and genetic features.

Gorlin Syndrome (Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome) is another name for basal cell nevus syndrome, which is a distinct genetic disorder that is characterized by a different set of clinical and genetic features.
